title: How to Do a Binary Search in Python
description: Use the bisect module to do a binary search in Python, then implement this classic algorithm yourself, both iteratively and recursively.
summary: Binary search is a classic algorithm in computer science. It often comes up in programming contests and technical interviews .
takeaways: Benchmarking In the next section of this tutorial, you’ll be using a subset of the Internet Movie Database (IMDb) to benchmark the performance of a few search algorithms.
Unless you’re curious or have a specific assignment, you should always leverage existing libraries to do a binary search in Python or any other language.
For example, you can read it with Pandas , use a dedicated application, or leverage a few command-line tools.
